title: Maine Bina Coding Seekhe App Banaya… Lekin Kya Ye Sahi Hai? #shorts
description:
Vibe Coding se app ban sakta hai — but kya ye sach mein programming hai ya time bomb? 💣

Full breakdown link in bio 👆

Stop Guessing. Start Knowing. | @codeorcap

characterStyleLock.style: Cinematic dark tech aesthetic, neon-lit cyberpunk atmosphere, dramatic contrast, 9:16 vertical aspect ratio, portrait orientation
characterStyleLock.locationLock: Modern tech environment, dark backgrounds with glowing screens and code elements

scenes.text: Maine bina coding seekhe pura app bana diya! Ye sun ke achha lagta hai. Lekin kya ye sach mein programming hai — ya time bomb?
scenes.imagePrompt: Person speaking confidently to camera, laptop open showing lines of code generated by AI, dark tech studio background with neon glow, dramatic lighting, portrait orientation

scenes.text: Vibe coding matlab — AI ko English mein bolo, code khud likhega. Andrej Karpathy ne 2025 mein coin kiya. 92 percent developers ab aisa karte hain. 21 percent faster productivity. Real power hai is mein.
scenes.imagePrompt: Viral social media posts and tweets displayed on floating screens in dark space, glowing text about AI replacing programmers, dramatic neon lighting, portrait orientation

scenes.text: Lekin data dekho. Veracode: 45 percent AI code mein OWASP security holes. Carnegie Mellon: sirf 10.5 percent code security review paas karta hai. Aur real incident — ek vibe-coded app ne 15 lakh API keys leak kar diye. Bina ek bhi review ke.
scenes.imagePrompt: Red warning alerts and security breach notifications flooding dark screens, cracked code panels with glowing red vulnerabilities exposed, dramatic alarming cyberpunk aesthetic, portrait orientation

scenes.text: Fark samjho. Vibe coding code generate karta hai. Programming decide karta hai — wo code sahi hai ya nahi. Ye dono ek cheez nahi hain.
scenes.imagePrompt: Split screen comparison — left side glowing blue AI code generation fast and flashy, right side deep focused programmer understanding architecture, dramatic dividing line, portrait orientation

scenes.text: Verdict: Vibe coding accelerator hai — autopilot nahi. Is claim ko 10 mein se sirf 3. Mostly cap.
scenes.imagePrompt: Dramatic verdict reveal — large glowing CAP stamp over viral claim text, truth meter showing 3 out of 10, dark cinematic courtroom-style lighting with red and yellow accents, portrait orientation

scenes.text: Programming seekhna mat chhodo. Subscribe karo — CodeOrCap pe hum evidence se chalte hain.
scenes.imagePrompt: CodeOrCap brand logo glowing in dark space, subscribe button animation, developer community collage, hopeful empowering lighting with yellow and orange neon accents, portrait orientation
